top_signals.title: Thai PM Anutin’s Support Drops in Latest Poll as Pressures Rise
top_signals.summary: Public support for Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul and his Bhumjaithai Party has plunged, according to an opinion poll, as his government confronts rising oil prices and a court ruling that may threaten its hold on power.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

U.S. Soldier Gets 70 Months in Prison for AT&T, Verizon Extortions
top_signals.summary: A U.S. Army soldier who pleaded guilty to hacking into multiple telecommunications companies and stealing mobile call and text metadata for more than 100 million AT&T customers in 2024 was sentenced to 70 months in federal prison today and ordered to pay nearly $300,000 in restitution to victims.
